segments.description: Provides AI-enabled software, edge hardware and services that monitor, optimize and operate solar, storage and hybrid energy assets for asset owners, developers and operators.
segments.evidence: PowerTrack is our integrated suite of software and solutions for solar, storage and hybrid assets.

revenueModel.text: Project developers, asset owners, construction firms and distributors pay for software, edge hardware and project, managed and professional services.
revenueModel.evidence: We serve project developers, asset owners, engineering, procurement and construction firms (EPCs) and distributors.

changes.text: In 2024 the company shifted away from battery resales, which had historically been most of its revenue, toward software, edge and services.
changes.evidence: including reduction of what had historically been the source of most of our revenue (battery resales), adjustments to the way we develop and market our products and services
